description: This file defines the 'OutboundSignal' interface and its nested interfaces, constants, and documentation. It models outbound signals sent from the Eclipse Ditto framework to external targets, including methods for accessing source signals, target lists, and related functionalities.

classes.name: OutboundSignal
classes.description: Represents an outbound signal sent from Ditto to an external target, providing methods to access source signal, targets, and additional optional data.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mappable
classes.description: Interface extending OutboundSignal with payload mapping information.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mapped
classes.description: Interface extending OutboundSignal with access to the mapped external message and adaptable protocol message.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.MultiMapped
classes.description: Interface representing a collection of mapped outbound signals derived from a single source signal.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static final definitions of JSON fields used in OutboundSignal, such as source, targets, and headers.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns a list of targets authorized to read and subscribe to the outbound signal.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Provides additional fields if the signal has been enriched; defaults to empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Outputs a JSON representation of the OutboundSignal, including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Outputs a JSON representation of the OutboundSignal given a specific schema version and field selector.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the PayloadMapping used for mapping the payload to targets.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message mapped from the outbound signal.

methods.name: getAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the Ditto protocol message after adaptation.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first mapped outbound signal from a collection.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignals
methods.description: Returns a list of all mapped outbound signals.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender ActorRef of the original signal, if available.
